pages.title: Sambar
pages.text: The sambar ($(o)Rusa unicolor$()) is a large deer native to the forests of South Asia, southern China and Southeast Asia.$(br2)It has a coarse, dark brown coat, and stags carry long, three-tined antlers.$(br2)Sambar are mostly active at dusk and during the night, rarely stray far from water, and are one of the most important prey animals of the tiger.
